measured_interpretation: The GPU-aligned GPT-2 Medium source remained coherent enough to avoid collapse, but its online top-64 distribution reduced the exact deployed LayerCake to 7/28 passes, below both v41 and the locked screen gate. Improving an auxiliary source did not solve functional transfer into the three-block host.
decision: Reject before the 1,400-observation and CPU certification stages. Close the two-stage auxiliary-source soft-distillation branch without hyperparameter sweeps. Test direct, shape-compatible source-weight extraction into the existing LayerCake topology, explicitly account copied tensors, then use bounded GPU conformance to eliminate exact source-block retention before any promotion claim.
